source_instruction: i am looking for a  counter height size barstools of faux leather
query: Oh man, I just got back from walking my rescue terrier Mabel around the neighborhood park a little while ago, and she was absolutely determined to make friends with every single squirrel that darted up the oak trees along the path. She pulled so hard on her leash at one point that I tripped over a raised crack in the sidewalk and spilled half my iced oat milk latte right on the cuff of my favorite worn-in denim jacket, the one with the hand-stitched sunflower patch on the elbow I sewed on last spring. A group of little kids who were feeding ducks by the pond even laughed and pointed when Mabel dragged me over to say hi to their fluffy golden retriever puppy, and I had to stand there awkwardly wiping coffee off my jeans while the two dogs sniffed each other and wagged their tails so hard their whole bodies wiggled. I’m browsing the bar stools section right now and need ones made of faux leather, plus that one height style I always go for, yeah? Also they definitely need to come with a free attachable cup holder that clips right to the side, that’s non-negotiable for me. I don’t want to spend too much, so just keep the cost reasonable, yeah? Wait, make sure the faux leather is that smooth matte kind too, I hate the super shiny cheap stuff.
